title: CubeAssembler CubeLab moves block v2
description: The JSON inside <script type="application/json" id="cubelab-moves"> on the 3D cube view: the cube size (2 to 15; the app writes v2 from size 8) and the move history exactly as the Moves line shows it, in layer-prefix/v2 (layer numbers 2 to 15, one or two digits). Fields may be added without a new spec version, so readers ignore unknown fields.

moves.description: Space-separated turns, empty when there are none.
